scenarios.name: Byzantine leader equivocation
scenarios.fault: Leader sends conflicting duplicate blocks via malicious repair
scenarios.detail: Finalized 32 roots despite the equivocating leader

scenarios.name: Kill the heaviest partition
scenarios.fault: Split into 4 partitions, then kill the most-staked one
scenarios.detail: Remaining validators recovered and re-rooted after the drop

scenarios.name: Three-way network partition
scenarios.fault: Split stake into 3 equal partitions, then heal
scenarios.detail: Cluster reunited and finalized once the split resolved

scenarios.name: Validator restart
scenarios.fault: Kill a validator mid-run and restart it
scenarios.detail: Node restarted and the cluster kept finalizing
